semantics.dialect_defined: XML entrypoint-closure membership only; primary request dialect and auxiliary-only definitions remain separate.
semantics.static_supported: Exact heuristic reference status from the merged static evidence; neither presence nor absence is a support proof.
semantics.static_direction: Mechanical grouping of existing TX and RX/handler reference counts; it is not path reachability.
semantics.static_requestable: UNKNOWN for every static definition because the existing static catalog has no explicit requestability field.
semantics.baseline_observed: Observed in this selected default SITL profile only; zero is not unsupported evidence.
semantics.requested_window_observed: A matching frame occurred in the sequential request window; periodic baseline traffic can make causality ambiguous.
semantics.request_ack: Exact ACK result only. DENIED and FAILED are not rewritten as UNSUPPORTED; ACK 512 lacks the requested message ID.
semantics.support_inference: No global support/conformance boolean is produced.
